scope: Admin dashboard merchant API connections and default integration tab
behavior: Admin dashboard and Merchant Source Profiles list one merchant/environment row for each API key environment.
Connected requires an active merchant, at least one active unexpired key, and a recorded successful POST to the transaction or batch intake endpoint.
A generated key without a successful intake request is shown as Awaiting first success.
Live and Sandbox use their key's immutable environment; failed and mismatched-merchant log rows cannot establish connection success.
Admin API Integrations opens and refreshes on Merchant Source Profiles; BIR provider controls remain in their separate tabs.
List includes merchant profile image, formatted TIN, active key count, successful request count and PHT activity timestamps.
Search, environment filters, refresh, and bottom-of-table pagination are available on both admin surfaces.
Activity timestamps include the configured database-write timezone offset before browser conversion to PHT.
security: Read-only admin/super_admin endpoint; existing authentication, device binding and MFA boundary enforced. No credentials, private payloads or request IPs returned. No schema or stored-record changes.

validation.build: TypeScript, Laravel Vite and static Vite production builds
browser: Refresh returns to Merchant Source Profiles
Dashboard view link and five-row pagination
